news.headline: MAJOR FLOODING CONTINUES FRI — NWS Melbourne 3:10 AM Fri: Flood Warning for the St. Johns River near Cocoa remains in effect until further notice — river at 18.6 ft at 2:15 AM Fri (flood stage 16.0 ft), forecast to stay in Major Flood Stage and crest at 18.7 ft, above the flood of record; Flood Warning for central Brevard until 8:30 AM Fri and Flood Watch for most of east-central Florida including Orange, Osceola, Seminole, Volusia and Brevard through Fri 7 PM
Construction set to begin within months on Roche Bobois St. Pete Tower — 29-story, 164-unit condo tower at 344 4th Street South in St. Petersburg, a $200 million project by Valor Capital

U.S. housing starts rose 9.9% in October to a 1.309 million annual rate — single-family starts up 4.0% to 864,000 — but building permits fell 7.4% to 1.295 million, with single-family permits down 8.7% to 772,000, lowest since January 2023; builder confidence fell 4 points to 25 in November, lowest since April 2012, with 46% of builders cutting prices

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31 — permit application date governs which edition applies; Miami-Dade portal cutoff is 4 PM Dec 30, with new flood documentation and coastal corrosion rules
Copper holds near seven-month low — COMEX copper closed Thu Nov 19 at $5.63/lb, and LME copper fell 1.4% on the day to $12,570/ton, as a strong dollar and demand doubts weighed on prices

Regency Electric acquires Tekline Electrical Services of Chandler, AZ — deal closed Nov 3, terms undisclosed, expanding the Colorado commercial electrical contractor into Arizona; Tekline serves manufacturing, healthcare, education, hospitality and industrial markets

Fed minutes released Wed Nov 18 read hawkish — almost all October FOMC participants judged further rate hikes likely in months ahead to return inflation to 2%; funds held at 3.75–4.00%, next meeting Dec 8–9, with markets pricing over 90% odds of a December hike

Markets fell hard Thu Nov 19 — S&P 500 down 2.0% to 7,176 for a sixth straight loss, Nasdaq down 2.25% to 23,886 and the Dow down about 1,100 points as investors retreated from growth stocks; initial jobless claims for the week ending Nov 14 came in at 203,000 vs. 197,000 expected

NBA: Heat 137, Bucks 130 on Wed — Miami's 6th straight win, Bam Adebayo 26 pts; 76ers 121, Magic 116 — Joel Embiid 26 pts, Franz Wagner 27 pts for Orlando; Magic (6-8) play tonight Fri Nov 20 at the Brooklyn Nets (3-11), 7:30 PM ET at Barclays Center, with Paolo Banchero out (ankle)
NFL Week 11 Sun Nov 22 — all Florida teams on the road: Buccaneers (3-6) at Lions (7-2) 1 PM ET, Dolphins (1-8) at Bills (8-1) 1 PM ET, Jaguars (7-2) at Giants (5-3-1) 4:25 PM ET
